descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use for tasks to look at, examine, or read an object under a lamp/desklamp (e.g. 'look at the book under the desklamp'). Find the object, then turn on the light.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for plain tasks moving ONE object to a place: 'put a X in/on Y', 'move X to Y', 'put away X'. No cleaning, heating, or cooling, and no count of two.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says clean, wash, rinse, or wet/clean/dirty object, or a clean object is implied, then put it somewhere (even a microwave or fridge). Use the sinkbasin to clean.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says cool, chill, cold, or cooled object, then put it somewhere. Use the fridge to cool it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says heat, warm, hot, or cook an object, then put it somewhere. Use the microwave or stove. It also fits cook then put in fridge.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task involves TWO objects of the same type: 'two X', 'both', plural X with a count, or 'put away two'. Pick up and place each in turn.
